scope: Eight passenger-airport reference locations. Excludes military, restricted-use, inactive and proposed airfields. Not a live operating-status, flight-route or freight-capacity dataset.

selectionVerification.note: Independent contemporary cross-check of the same eight passenger airports, not a substitute for flight verification.

recentRouteEvidence.note: Reports airline announcement for Jashore resumption and other domestic destinations; scheduled service does not establish flights actually operated.

reuse: Attributed authority facts only; no authority prose or imagery republished. OSM coordinates retain ODbL attribution.
coordinateMethod: OSM aerodrome bounding-box centres; overview anchors, not entrances, aerodrome reference points or routing destinations.
limitations: Source-page dates are distinct from retrieval dates. CAAB profiles contain older information; no international certification, terminal commissioning, current capacity or flight frequency is asserted.
Documented cargo infrastructure at Dhaka, Chattogram and Sylhet does not imply cargo capability is absent elsewhere, nor establish available freight services.
